checks.text: Clicking the button "Add recipe" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Name" with "Pancakes", the field labelled "Servings" with "4", and clicking "Save" adds a row to the table containing "Pancakes" and "4".
In the search box, typing "pan" shows a result with "Pancakes" highlighted, and the table shows only the Pancakes row.
Clicking the column header "Name" in the table sorts the rows alphabetically by name.
Clicking the button "Edit Pancakes" opens the form with "Pancakes" pre-filled. Changing the field labelled "Servings" to "6" and clicking "Save" updates the table row to show "6".
Clicking the button "Delete Pancakes" removes the row from the table.
Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file containing the header "Name,Servings" and the row "Pancakes,4".
With no recipes, the table shows the text "No recipes yet".
Reload keeps the recipe "Pancakes" with servings "4" visible in the table.
